competitors.name: Hampton Fitness
competitors.observation: Treats the connection eye as a key load-transfer point; its model claims were reviewed but not generalized.

competitors.name: Public buyer discussions
competitors.observation: Show the language buyers use after equipment incidents; anecdotes were excluded from technical claims.

rejectedTopics: Container loading — export-packaging and landed-cost owners already cover the intent.
Batch traceability — reorder-consistency content owns the intent.
Plate thickness — bumper-plate sleeve-capacity content owns the intent.
Selectorized dumbbell locking — the fixed-versus-adjustable guide already covers the sample and service decision.
siteGaps: No existing page owns the joint drawing → procedure evidence → pre-finish visual examination → lot containment workflow for cable attachments.

sources.title: ISO 17637:2016 visual testing of fusion-welded joints
sources.use: Scope boundary for visual examination of metallic fusion welds and possible pre-weld joint examination.

sources.title: ISO 5817:2023 quality levels for imperfections
sources.use: Primary standard summary used to distinguish production workmanship levels from complete-product fitness.

sources.title: ISO 15607:2019 general rules for welding procedures
sources.use: Primary framework for procedure specification and qualification; no application-specific requirement is assumed.

sources.title: ISO 10042:2018 quality levels for aluminium weld imperfections
sources.use: Material-specific boundary showing that production quality levels do not by themselves establish fitness for purpose.

sources.title: ISO 20957-1:2024 stationary training equipment
sources.use: Training-equipment scope reviewed; exact applicability to an accessory and market must be confirmed rather than assumed.

sources.title: Hampton Fitness cable-machine attachment guide
sources.use: Competitor terminology for connection points reviewed; brand-specific durability and failure claims were not reused as universal facts.

sources.title: Reddit discussion of a crossover attachment failure
sources.use: Buyer-language and inspection concern only; the anecdote is not treated as engineering or product proof.

limitations: Quora pages were not used because automated verification was blocked; no claim depends on them.
Reddit posts were used only to understand buyer wording, never as product or engineering evidence.
The scheduled paid keyword refresh is reserved for Sunday under the shared policy; this Wednesday run used public search, live sitemaps and the existing registry.
An exact application standard and acceptance level must be selected for the product, material, market and contract; the guide does not prescribe one universally.
